verdict.rationale: Honeybadger supports autonomous background automations like Alarms (BadgerQL query + threshold triggering alerts) and anomaly detection that continuously monitor without user intervention, plus auto-resolution on deploy. However, these are traditional monitoring rules rather than AI-agent-configured or AI-native automations; the MCP integration is framed as interactive assistant queries rather than autonomous background jobs. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-native/agent-triggered automation setup, natural-language automation creation, or autonomous multi-step agent workflows beyond query/investigate.
